calvino_source.inner_arch: Listing desires one by one stifles them, whereas standing in the middle of Anastasia awakens all desires simultaneously around you so no desire is lost—yet working eight hours a day as a cutter of agate, onyx, and chrysoprase gives crystalline form to desire while taking from desire its living form, making you Anastasia's contented slave precisely when you believe you enjoy her wholly.
calvino_source.anti_trude_vector: Concentric iris-canal & wind-kite sensory panorama coupled to a central water-driven chalcedony lapidary wheel and 8-hour shift escapement. Un-yoked motion awakens canals, kites, cherry-wood/marjoram embers, and garden-pool bathers simultaneously (while cataloging any single desire alone dims and stifles the rest). Engaging the gem-cutter's wheel to facet agate, onyx, chrysoprase, and chalcedony progressively locks free cursor/camera vectors into a captive 8-hour rhythmic grinding orbit: the city blazes brighter with every facet cut, while the beholder's own agency contracts to zero.

anastasia-lapidary-yoke.mandate: Build window.AnastasiaChalcedonyWheel implementing the interactive copper lapidary arbor, brass dop-stick & 24-index tang, multi-band optical stone cutting for agate, onyx, chrysoprase, and chalcedony, and the 8-hour shift-escapement agency converter that transforms free desire vectors into captive rhythmic servitude while boosting cityRadianceBoost.
